full_text_en:
Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant and Liu Xianchi v. Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant  

Dispute over Infringement of Technical Secrets  

Promulgated by the Supreme People's Court (2000) No. 1  

SUPREME PEOPLE'S COURT OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA  

CIVIL JUDGMENT  

(1999) Zhi Zhong Zi No. 5  

Appellants (defendants at first instance): Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant, domiciled at Shuangdong Town, Luoding City, Guangdong Province.  

Legal representative: Huang Xiangning, Manager of the plant.  

Agent ad litem: Pan Can, Cadre of the Legal Affairs Bureau of Luoding Municipal People's Government, Guangdong Province.  

Appellant (defendant at first instance): Liu Xianchi, male, 54 years old, born in Anren County, Hunan Province, formerly Group Leader of the Process Group and Engineer of Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant, domiciled at Unit 32, Building 701, Dormitory Village No. 1, Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant.  

Respondent (plaintiff at first instance): Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant, domiciled at Xiangshi West Road, Zhuzhou City, Hunan Province.  

Legal representative: Xu Linkun, Manager of the plant.  

Agent ad litem: Zhou Shoukang, Deputy Manager of the plant.  

Agent ad litem: Zhang Tingzhi, Lawyer of Beijing Tianyuan Law Firm.  

In the dispute over infringement of technical secrets between Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant (hereinafter referred to as Luoding Plant) and Hunan Province Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant (hereinafter referred to as Zhuzhou Plant) and Liu Xianchi, Luoding Plant appealed against the civil judgment (1996) Xiang Gao Fa Jing Er Chu Zi No. 9 rendered by the High People's Court of Hunan Province. This Court issued a civil ruling (1996) Zhi Zhong Zi No. 1, setting aside the original judgment and remanding the case for retrial. After retrial, the High People's Court of Hunan Province rendered the civil judgment (1997) Xiang Gao Jing Chu Zi No. 25. Both Appellants Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi, dissatisfied with the retrial judgment, appealed to this Court again. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and conducted a trial. The trial has now been concluded.  

Upon trial, it is found that:  

Zhuzhou Plant began production of "xanthate" in 1966. Starting in 1975, the plant conducted research to address issues in the xanthate production synthesis technology, including unstable quality, material leakage, difficulty in temperature control, and fire hazards. In 1981, the key equipment for xanthate production, the "kneader" and the "ball mill air classification system," were redesigned, manufactured, and installed, reducing production costs and improving production safety and product quality. The xanthate series products produced by this plant have stable quality: its butyl xanthate won the National Silver Product Award in 1982 and 1987 and was named a Hunan Province Famous Brand Product in 1981 and 1989; its ethyl xanthate won the Ministry Excellent Product Award in 1983 and 1988 and was named a Hunan Province High-Quality Product Award in 1982, 1985, and 1990.  

Zhuzhou Plant implemented confidentiality measures for its technical achievements, issuing the "Confidentiality and Archiving Work System" and "Science and Technology Archives Management Standard," which stipulate that scientific and technological archives may not be copied, transcribed, or lent without authorization, and generally may not be borrowed without leadership approval.  

Liu Xianchi graduated from Wuhan Iron and Steel Institute and served successively as technician in the CS (xanthate raw material) workshop, deputy director of the reagent workshop, director of the CS workshop, deputy director of the design office, and group leader of the xanthate process group of the design office at Zhuzhou Plant. In October 1990, he was approached by Luoding Plant and asked to provide equipment drawings and technology for xanthate production. The parties orally agreed that Liu Xianchi would handle the technical work and Luoding Plant would pay a remuneration of RMB 40,000, with RMB 20,000 payable upon delivery of the drawings and the remaining RMB 20,000 payable after successful trial operation. Thereafter, by the end of May 1991, Liu Xianchi delivered to Huang Wuyi of Luoding Plant all equipment drawings (including blueprints, originals, and white prints totaling four volumes of 181 sheets). Liu Xianchi marked the designer on the drawings as "Liu Shunzhi" (a homophone of Liu Xianchi) and the unit as "Yuanlilai Technology Development Company" (which did not exist), and received the agreed RMB 20,000. Luoding Plant then entrusted these drawings to Guangzhou Kunlun Company for processing. During this period, at Luoding Plant's request, Liu Xianchi went to Kunlun Company to guide equipment production. After the equipment was produced, Luoding Plant again invited Liu Xianchi to install it. Liu Xianchi invited three retired workers from Zhuzhou Plant to install the equipment in Luoding Plant and also went alone to Luoding Plant to guide the trial operation. In November 1991, the trial operation succeeded, and Luoding Plant paid Liu Xianchi another RMB 20,000. Liu Xianchi designed two production units with a total capacity of 1,200 tons for Luoding Plant, and Luoding Plant installed two more units based on the drawings, bringing the capacity to 2,000 tons, mainly producing ethyl xanthate and butyl xanthate. Luoding Plant used the above equipment to produce xanthate until the equipment was dismantled in April 1997.  

During the first instance of this case, the original trial court commissioned the Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Commission to organize a technical appraisal. The appraisal results were: 1. The key equipment for xanthate production synthesis technology of Zhuzhou Plant, the kneader, was designed by the plant based on years of production experience and was at a leading domestic level, constituting proprietary technology of the plant. 2. The ball mill air classification system used by Zhuzhou Plant for xanthate production was a technical achievement formed through self-design and debugging, constituting technical know-how of the plant. 3. The drawings of the key equipment for xanthate production synthesis technology acquired by Luoding Plant were reproductions of Zhuzhou Plant's drawings. 4. The design drawings of the ball mill air classification system for xanthate production acquired by Luoding Plant involved the use of Zhuzhou Plant's technical know-how (plagiarized from drawings).  

During the retrial of this case, the original trial court again commissioned the Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Commission to organize an appraisal. The appraisal conclusion was: 1. The key equipment for xanthate production synthesis technology of Zhuzhou Plant, the kneader, was self-improved, designed, and manufactured by the plant based on years of production experience, possessing five technologies: good sealing performance, effective explosion-proofing, accurate temperature control, reliable variable load performance, and a unique discharge valve. The ball mill air classification system, self-designed, debugged, and gradually formed by the plant, possesses five technologies: closed-circuit flow, gravity separator, modification of the blower, sealing devices at the inlet and outlet ends of the ball mill, and pipeline configuration. All these were in a secret state, unknown to the public, had practical value and relative progressiveness, could bring economic benefits to the right holder, and were subject to confidentiality measures taken by the plant, constituting technical secrets. 2. The drawings of the key equipment for xanthate production synthesis technology and the design drawings of the ball mill air classification system for xanthate production acquired and used by Luoding Plant were essentially reproductions of Zhuzhou Plant's drawings.  

During the retrial of this case, the original trial court commissioned Hunan Xiangsi Audit Office to audit the profits of Luoding Plant from producing and selling xanthate. The conclusion was: From January 1992 to the end of December 1997, Luoding Plant's sales revenue from xanthate was RMB 35,355,011.44, product sales profit was RMB 5,167,753.47; after deducting management expenses, financial expenses, etc., total profit was RMB 1,292,060.89; net profit after income tax was RMB 412,358.74. According to the audit report conclusion and the accounting data provided by the parties, from January 1993 to April 1997, the plant's sales revenue from xanthate was RMB 29,988,782.92, product sales profit was RMB 4,206,430.80, and operating profit was RMB 816,736.99.  

In June 1992, based on clues from public reports, Zhuzhou Plant reported to the People's Procuratorate of Beiqu District, Zhuzhou City, accusing Liu Xianchi of selling the plant's technical materials and committing embezzlement. During the investigation, the procuratorate recovered the RMB 40,000 received by Liu Xianchi and handed it over to Zhuzhou Plant. On December 20, 1994, the procuratorate issued a procuratorial suggestion letter to Zhuzhou Plant, stating that the investigation into Liu Xianchi's case had been concluded and suggesting that Zhuzhou Plant file a lawsuit with the people's court against Liu Xianchi and Luoding Plant for infringement.  

On December 20, 1994, Zhuzhou Plant filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Zhuzhou City, Hunan Province, against Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi, seeking legal liability for jointly infringing its technical secrets. After Luoding Plant raised a jurisdictional dispute, this Court designated the High People's Court of Hunan Province to hear the case.  

During the second instance of this case, Zhuzhou Plant acknowledged that its claim for damages could be calculated from 1993 to April 1997.  

The original trial court held after retrial that: Zhuzhou Plant possessed its own technical secrets in its xanthate production equipment, the kneader and the ball mill air classification system, which was confirmed by the appraisal of the Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Commission, and this Court affirms; Zhuzhou Plant implemented strict confidentiality measures for its technical secrets and never disclosed them publicly, and after being used in production, these technical secrets produced good economic and social benefits; therefore, Zhuzhou Plant's above technical secrets are not yet publicly known technology and should be protected by law. Luoding Plant, knowing that Zhuzhou Plant produced xanthate, used improper means to jointly commit infringement with Liu Xianchi and should bear legal liability. The purpose of Luoding Plant in obtaining the technical secrets was to manufacture equipment for xanthate production, and from the start of trial production in November 1991 until the equipment was dismantled at the end of August 1997, its conduct constituted continuous infringement. In accordance with Article 61, Paragraph 2, Article 118, Article 139, and Article 140 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the court ordered: 1. Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant shall compensate Hunan Province Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant for economic losses in the amount of RMB 4,155,882.07, to be paid in a lump sum within fifteen days from the date this judgment takes effect. 2. Liu Xianchi shall compensate Hunan Province Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant for economic losses in the amount of RMB 50,000 (including the RMB 40,000 remuneration paid by Luoding Plant). Court acceptance fees, property preservation fees totaling RMB 50,000, appraisal fees of RMB 15,000, and audit fees of RMB 80,000, totaling RMB 145,000, shall be borne by Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant.  

Luoding Plant, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed, alleging: The retrial judgment's finding of fact regarding the existence of technical secrets was unclear; the finding that Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi constituted joint infringement was erroneous; the statute of limitations for this case had expired; the order for Luoding Plant to compensate more than RMB 4.15 million had no factual or legal basis; the judgment was manifestly unjust; and the allocation of court fees, appraisal fees, and audit fees was unreasonable. It requested the court of second instance to set aside the original judgment and dismiss Zhuzhou Plant's claims.  

Liu Xianchi, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed, alleging: The technical arguments in the retrial judgment were insufficient; the statute of limitations had expired; and the RMB 40,000 remuneration paid by Luoding Plant should only be partially turned over.  

Zhuzhou Plant argued in response: The original judgment's findings of fact were clear and applicable law was correct, and it should be affirmed; the infringement committed by the two appellants was against intangible property, and as long as they did not stop using the equipment, the infringement was continuously ongoing; therefore, the statute of limitations had not expired, and the limitation period should start from December 1994 when the procuratorate issued a judicial suggestion; it was only after the procuratorate concluded its investigation into Liu Xianchi's case that Zhuzhou Plant had sufficient evidence.  

This Court holds: The technology in dispute in this case was appraised twice, confirming that the key equipment for xanthate production synthesis technology of Zhuzhou Plant, the kneader, possesses five technologies: good sealing performance, effective explosion-proofing, accurate temperature control, reliable variable load performance, and a unique discharge valve; the ball mill air classification system, self-designed, debugged, and gradually formed by the plant, possesses five technologies: closed-circuit flow, gravity separator, modification of the blower, sealing devices at the inlet and outlet ends of the ball mill, and pipeline configuration, all of which were in a secret state and unknown to the public. Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi objected to the above appraisal conclusions, claiming that the technical secrets had been publicly disclosed, but they did not provide sufficient evidence; the relevant technical materials they provided did not contain the content of the above technical secrets; therefore, the above appraisal conclusions should be adopted. Zhuzhou Plant established strict confidentiality measures to protect its technical secrets; these technical secrets could be applied in production and generated actual benefits; Zhuzhou Plant's above technical secrets meet the protection conditions stipulated in the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China and the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China and should be protected by law. Luoding Plant, knowing that Zhuzhou Plant was a professional manufacturer of xanthate, privately approached Liu Xianchi, who possessed the technology, to obtain the relevant technology for the plant's production equipment, and after obtaining Zhuzhou Plant's technical drawings, reproduced and plagiarized them for manufacturing equipment to produce and sell xanthate, constituting infringement of others' trade secrets; Liu Xianchi, for remuneration, provided Zhuzhou Plant's strictly confidential technical drawings to Luoding Plant, disclosing Zhuzhou Plant's technical secrets, jointly constituting infringement of trade secrets with Luoding Plant; Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi shall bear joint liability for infringing trade secrets. Although Luoding Plant obtained the relevant technology from Liu Xianchi in May 1991 and subsequently manufactured the equipment, the infringing act and result of using the equipment for production continued until April 1997 when the equipment was dismantled. During this period, Luoding Plant, through the use of the equipment, continuously utilized the effectiveness of Zhuzhou Plant's technical secrets, ensuring safe, normal production and product quality. Although Zhuzhou Plant only reported to the procuratorate requesting to pursue Liu Xianchi's legal liability and did not file a claim with the people's court for Luoding Plant's infringing liability, there was no evidence that Zhuzhou Plant clearly knew that its rights were being infringed by Luoding Plant before the procuratorate concluded its investigation and issued a procuratorial suggestion in December 1994; therefore, Zhuzhou Plant's lawsuit against Luoding Plant on December 20 of the same year did not exceed the statute of limitations; its reporting to the procuratorate based on public clues to pursue Liu Xianchi, and awaiting the conclusion of the procuratorate's investigation before filing a civil lawsuit, should be considered as interrupting the statute of limitations from the time of its report; therefore, Zhuzhou Plant's lawsuits against Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi did not exceed the statute of limitations. After consulting the opinions of both parties, Zhuzhou Plant agreed that the compensation liability should be calculated from 1993; therefore, the calculation period for compensation in this case is from 1993 to April 1997 when Luoding Plant dismantled the equipment. Zhuzhou Plant's request to infer its profits based on Luoding Plant's production capacity, arguing that Luoding Plant's product sales ledger totals did not match the detailed accounts, the profit figures were unreliable, and the audit conducted by the audit office based on such accounts, and the audit conclusions based on that, were unreliable, has some merit, but compared to its request to "infer profits based on Luoding Plant's production capacity," it is more reasonable to determine the compensation amount by referring to the audit results and comprehensively considering the circumstances of the entire case. The original judgment, except for incorrectly determining the time when Luoding Plant dismantled the equipment, was correct in other factual findings; the judgment found that Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi jointly infringed Zhuzhou Plant's technical secrets, but failed to order the two parties to bear joint liability for infringement in accordance with Article 130 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, which is improper; in addition, applying only the provisions of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, rather than the relevant provisions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, to deal with the infringing acts of Luoding Plant and Liu Xianchi, and calculating the infringing profit based on sales profit, were also improper. After discussion and decision by the Judicial Committee of this Court, in accordance with Article 61, Paragraph 2, Article 118, Article 130, Article 139, and Article 140 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 10, Paragraph 1, Item (2) and Article 20 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, this Court hereby orders:  

1. Item 1 of the civil judgment (1997) Xiang Gao Jing Chu Zi No. 15 of the High People's Court of Hunan Province is amended as follows: Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant shall pay Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant compensation for economic losses in the amount of RMB 816,736.99, plus interest on a comparable bank loan for the same period from April 1997 until the date of enforcement of this judgment. Payment shall be made within fifteen days from the date of service of this judgment. Liu Xianchi shall be jointly and severally liable for the above amount.  

2. Item 2 of the civil judgment (1997) Xiang Gao Jing Chu Zi No. 25 of the High People's Court of Hunan Province is amended as follows: Liu Xianchi shall pay Zhuzhou Mineral Processing Reagent Plant compensation for economic losses in the amount of RMB 40,000. This amount has already been paid and shall not be paid again.  

Court acceptance fees for first instance, property preservation fees, appraisal fees, and audit fees totaling RMB 145,000 shall be borne by Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant. Court acceptance fees for second instance of RMB 27,010 shall be borne by Guangdong Province Luoding Forest Products Chemical Plant in the amount of RMB 25,010 and by Liu Xianchi in the amount of RMB 2,000.  

This judgment is final.  

Presiding Judge: Jiang Zhipei  
Judge: Dong Tianping  
Acting Judge: Zhang Hui  

May 9, 2000
